changes: Only p=2 prime-power prefix/reciprocal-prefix loops; pair odd index with next even index, handle leading/trailing parity separately. No table/layout/ownership/API/COM changes.
conditions: /usr/bin/g++ GCC15.2; Clang21 GCC15 stdlib; -O2 C++23, SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS, default/native separately
same executable inode/path, shuffled baseline/control/pair, 17 repeats final main, 11/17 API repeats
results: GCC large pow2 cold construction ~31–40% shorter, incremental preparation ~27–32% shorter; Clang ~20–25% shorter.
Fixed existing integer main pow2 workloads ~5–6% shorter GCC, ~2–3% Clang. Prime-mod mains essentially control.
No claim of universal zero regression. Report raw medians/control; small fluctuations in unrelated paths.
rejected: BMI2 factorial clone alone: no stable general gain.
Wrapper table values avoid zero initialization but cause up to~59% prepared-query and up to~42% construction regressions in other shapes.

Overwrite allocator alternatives improve cold construction but up to~13% prepared-query regression; page-touch variants smaller query differences but add complexity and insufficient advantage over pair-only. No allocator or page-touch code adopted.
decision.simd: No added SIMD/CPU dispatch; this is portable integer loop simplification.
decision.provenance: Independently derived same-prefix identity for odd/even indices, no third-party implementation copied.

validation.reference: prefix/factorial independent cpp_int incremental and copy boundaries, 171-modulus prior reference (~4.8M queries/config), allocation failure/recovery
